# Test on PBMC dataset
library(DrumSCircle)
library(gganimate)

load("data/pbmc_pca.RData")

o <- prep_umaps(pbmc_pca[,1:10])
p <- animate_umaps(o, pbmc_clust) + labs(color = "Cluster")

p
